# A bare `txn_guid:` block whose `amount:` is not a number.
#
# Nothing parses that figure earlier on this spelling — the block names its
# transaction and lets the importer find the split — so the first thing to read
# it is the check that compares it against what the split carries. It says so
# rather than failing somewhere further in with a figure nobody stated.
invoice "INV-NOT-A-NUMBER"
	customer_id: "C-TWO-A"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-05-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-05-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-05-02
		due: 2026-06-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-NOT-A-NUMBER"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-05-15
		amount: "one hundred"
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		memo: "Portion for Alpha"
